## Preview Customization Overview

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/preview-customization-overview/>

With the Spacious Premium theme, you can customize your Personal/Business website to your own selection of Fonts, Colors, Layouts and different styles for it. Moreover, it additionally has simple customization choices for custom widgets and different widget areas. This can truly expand the usefulness of your site as well.

**Key Features:**

- Advanced Header Options
- Advanced Footer Options
- More Blog Layout
- More WooCommerce Features
- Advanced Typography Options
- 100+ Customizer Options
- Page Settings
- Multiple Widget Areas
- Awesome Support
